name: Gladias and Seila's house
about: The family home in Meldan where Gladias, Seila and the children eat, argue and get bad news. The book gives only the details listed below; the rest of the design is invented, and contributors are welcome to replace it.

facts.quote: They heard loud footsteps coming down the stairs.
facts.fact: The house has an upper floor reached by stairs.

facts.quote: She ran forward, and sat down on the couch.
facts.fact: A couch in the main room.

facts.quote: Gladias, Seila, Zven and Febric sat at the table and waited.
A small roof covered the area right in front of the doorstep.
facts.fact: A small roof shelters the doorstep.

facts.quote: He then tapped his watch against a glowing green circle beside the door.
facts.fact: A glowing green circle beside the front door.

facts.quote: He went down a set of stairs to the basement
light coming in clean through the window, the trees on the footpath outside already throwing long morning shadows
facts.fact: A window onto trees and a footpath.

facts.quote: picked up two bags from a robot
